get.summary: Players ranked by a statistic, ties sharing a place
get.description:
Online players count live. Use a preset or any statistic as `category:key`, such as `custom:jump`, `mined:diamond_ore`, or `killed:*`. The `experience` preset starts each player from the game's `XpTotal` (experience since their last death, so a lower bound) and adds every pickup after that, since vanilla keeps no lifetime statistic.

Scope: `read`.

parameters.name: statistic
parameters.description: A preset (`playtime`, `diamonds`, `advancements`, `mobs`, `travel`, `deaths`, `blocks`, `fish`, `damage`) or any statistic as `category:key`, such as `custom:jump` or `killed:*`

parameters.name: limit

post.summary: Load a script that stays: it can listen to events and schedule tasks
post.description:
Scripts are Java, compiled on the server. They may use Java and the Paper API only; blocked calls are listed in config.yml. Off unless scripts.enabled is true, and every call needs the code scope, which admin doesn't include. The class's `enable(ctx)` runs on the server thread. Register listeners with `ctx.on(...)` and tasks with `ctx.every(...)`: unloading removes them.

Scope: `code`.

503.description: The server thread didn't answer in time

post.summary: Compile and run Java once, and return what it returns
post.description:
Scripts are Java, compiled on the server. They may use Java and the Paper API only; blocked calls are listed in config.yml. Off unless scripts.enabled is true, and every call needs the code scope, which admin doesn't include. Send a class implementing WorldApiScript, or just the body of `run`: `return server.getOnlinePlayers().size();`. `ctx` and `server` are in scope. The script unloads as soon as it returns.

Scope: `code`.

get.summary: Find the nearest blocks of some types, or the nearest biome
get.description:
Block search looks through chunks that are already loaded and never loads more; `unloadedChunks` says how many it skipped. It reads copies of those chunks off the server thread, within limits.maxBlockSearchRadius. It needs a token whatever the anonymous settings say, because it would show ores and ancient debris through walls. Biome search asks the world generator, so it works in unexplored land too; it runs on the server thread, within limits.maxBiomeSearchRadius. Anonymous clients may search biomes only when they may see coordinates.

Scope: `read`.

parameters.name: blocks
parameters.description: Block keys or tags, separated by commas: `minecraft:diamond_ore,#minecraft:logs`

parameters.name: biome
parameters.description: Biome keys, separated by commas; the nearest of any counts: `minecraft:cherry_grove`

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Center Y; required for blocks, 64 by default for biomes

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Block search radius in blocks (32 by default)

parameters.name: biomeRadius
parameters.description: Biome search radius in blocks (1024 by default)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many blocks to return, nearest first (10 by default, at most 100)

get.summary: Find the nearest structure
get.description:
Searching can take a while and runs on the server thread, so the radius is capped by limits.maxStructureRadius (in chunks). `type` takes a structure key such as `minecraft:stronghold`, or a prefix such as `village` that matches every structure starting with it.

Scope: `read`.

parameters.description: Search from this X; defaults to the world spawn

parameters.name: z
parameters.description: Search from this Z; defaults to the world spawn

parameters.name: unexplored
parameters.description: Only structures nobody has found yet, as treasure maps do

get.summary: Stream events over a WebSocket
get.description:
Upgrade to a WebSocket. Authenticate with the Authorization header, or send `{"op":"auth","token":"…"}` as the first message. Never put the token in the URL.

Then subscribe: `{"op":"subscribe","topics":["player.join","world.time"],"filter":{"player":"Steve"}}`. The server answers `subscribed`, a `snapshot` of the current state where a topic has one, then `event` messages as things happen. `heartbeat` arrives every few seconds; `dropped` says how many events a slow client missed.

Topics: `player.join`, `player.leave`, `player.kick`, `player.death`, `player.respawn`, `player.advancement`, `player.chat`, `player.command`, `player.move`, `player.world_change`, `player.portal`, `player.health`, `player.damage`, `player.kill`, `player.inventory`, `player.gamemode`, `player.level_up`, `player.sleep`, `player.fish`, `player.craft`, `player.enchant`, `player.trade`, `world.time`, `world.weather`, `world.night_skipped`, `world.lightning`, `world.load`, `world.unload`, `entity.boss_killed`, `entity.death`, `entity.explode`, `raid.start`, `raid.finish`, `block.break`, `block.place`, `server.performance`, `server.status`, `server.plugin`, `script.log`.

Scope: `read`.
